tei:div.tei:p: "_ "!#: :thugs sgrub yang snying 'dus pa las: las byang rin chen phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so:

ma bcos spros bral chos kyi sku: dpal ldan sangs rgyas pad+ma skyes: kun mkhyen ye shes mdzod 'dzin pa: rdo rje thod phreng rtsal la 'dud: bsod nams tshogs chen yongs rdzogs nas: bla med 'bras bu thob bya'i phyir: yang gsang sgrub pa'i las byang las: sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes dang gsum: sngon 'gro thun mong chos brgyad de: bka' bsgo mtshams bcad brda sgo dbye: brda phyag dam bca' mchod byin rlabs: dam bshags ma 'dres rang gsal gdab: dngos gzhi'i gzhung khrid nyi shu ste: ting 'dzin rnam gsum 'byung rim brtsegs: gzhal yas lha bskyed rang dbang bskur: spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol phyag mchod 'bul: sman gtor rak+ta sbyor sgrol dang: bstod bshags 'dzab bzlas gnad nas bskul: rjes kyi las 'grigs bcu bzhi ste: skong gso tshogs lhag thugs dam bskul: tha tshig gtor dbang tshe 'gugs shing: chad mdo gtor skyong rta bro dang: dkyil 'khor dal bsdu rgyun spyod bya: smon lam mtha' rgyas shis pa brjod: 'di dag las gzhung rtsa thor bsdebs: skal ldan gcig dang 'phrad nas kyang: gsang sngags bstan pa'i srog tu shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: sngon 'gro thun mong las brgyad las: dang po bgegs la bka' bsgo ba ni: hūm̐: bla ma rnams kyi byin rlabs dang: yi dam lha yi ting 'dzin dang: mkha' 'gro rnams kyi mthu rtsal gyis: dngos grub bar chad byed pa'i bgegs: log par 'dren pa bdud kyi tshogs: 'di ru ma 'dug gzhan du dengs: gal te mi 'gro 'dug gyur na: dbang chen khros pa'i ting 'dzin gyis: khro bo khro mo'i tshogs spros nas: khyod kyi lus ngag yid dang bcas: rdul phran bzhin du brlag par 'gyur: de bas ma 'dug gzhan du dengs: oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha ni hūm̐: gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūm̐: gṛh+ṇā pa ya gṛh+ṇā pa ya hūm̐: ā na ya ho: bha ga wān: bid+yā rā dzā ya hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ badz+ra kro dha da ha da ha pa tsa pa tsa ha na ha na u tsa ta ya hūm̐ phaṭa:

hūm̐: nga ni ye nas ngang gis khro: mtshams gcod khro bos nam mkha' gang: bgegs 'dul khro mo'i rol mtshams las: su yang 'da' bar ma byed cig: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrī: gu ru dhe wa dhā ki nīḥ badz+ra kro dha rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ phaṭa: gnyis pa mtshams bcad pa ni: hūm̐: nga ni rab 'jigs dbang gi sku: khro tshogs mang po sprin ltar gtibs: mtshon cha me dpung glog ltar 'gyu: bka' dang mtshams las ma 'da' zhig: oṃ badz+ra pad+ma kro dha: badz+ra tsakra tīk+ṣ+ṇa karmā kī la ya: dz+wa la raṃ bhi sha kro dha hūm̐ phaṭa: gsum pa brda sgo dbye ba ni: hūm̐: snang srid 'khor 'das bde chen zhing du brdal: snod bcud gzugs snang ye nas lha ru gsal: de nyid ma rtogs rang gsang thabs kyis bcad: rang gsal snying po brda yi sgo dbye 'tshal: bh+rūm̐ saṃskṛ ta dz+nyā na swā bhā wa pra we sha ya phaṭa: brda phyag 'tshal ba ni: hūm̐: kun bzang khyab brdal rang byung snying po'i don: ma rig gnyis 'dzin rtogs pa'i rkyen dbang gis: ye nas rang gsal gnyis med don dam mjal: rang ngo rang gsal don gyis mjal phyag 'tshal: sa ma ya a ti pū ho: bzhi pa dam bca' byin dbab pa ni/ hūm̐: chos dbyings rnam dag skye med pho brang nas: skye 'gag 'gyur med spros pa'i mtha' bral yang: thugs rje'i dam bca' dus las mi g.yel phyir: bla ma rig 'dzin yi dam dhā ki'i tshogs: dus gsum bde gshegs rgyal ba ma lus rnams: thugs dam dbang gis bdag la brtser dgongs nas: mi mngon dbyings nas gnas 'dir skur bzhengs shig: byin chen dbab cing dbang chen bskur du gsol: gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor dam rdzas ma lus la: sku gsung thugs kyi byin gyis brlab tu gsol: ye shes lnga yi dbang mchog bskur du gsol: oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya dza: gu ru dhe wa dhā ki nī bha ga wān: sarba sa ma ya: ā we sha ya a ā: lnga pa mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa ni: oṃ swa bhā wa bi shud+dhāḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wā bi shud+dho ྅haṃ:

dngos 'dzin dri ma dag cing stong par sbyangs: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis spel: sarba pañca a mṛta hūm̐ hrīḥṭha: ma hā ba liṃ ta te dzo ba liṃ ta bha la bha ti gu h+ya sa ma ya hūm̐ hrīḥṭha: ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐ hrīḥṭha: zhes sman gtor rak+ta byin gyis brlab: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐: badz+ra dhū pe ā hūm̐: badz+ra ā lo ke ā hūm̐: badz+ra gan+dhe ā hūm̐: badz+ra nai wi d+yā ā hūm̐: oṃ badz+ra shab+da āḥhūm̐: oṃ ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta kiṃ ni ri ti ma hā pañca oṃ āḥhūm̐: bho dhi tsit+ta ga ṇa gu h+ya pū tsa ho: de nas phyi nang gsang gsum gyi mchod pa byin gyis brlabs shing tshig gis gsal gdab pa ni: hūm̐: gsang ba bla ma'i dkyil 'khor du: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin rnams: snang srid thams cad yongs bkang nas: gus pas 'bul gyis bzhes su gsol: drug pa dam bca' bzung ste sor mo rnams bsnol te nang du bsdams la: hūm̐: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro bde gshegs rnams: dus gsum 'du 'bral med pa'i dkyil 'khor 'dir: sems nyid ngang du ma 'dres yongs rdzogs la: skad cig tsam yang mi gtong bsgrub par bgyi: tsit+ta badz+ra sa mā ti hūm̐: bdun pa bshags pa bya ba ni: hrī: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dgongs: khyed ni rnam dag dri ma med: bdag ni nyon mongs sgrib pas bsgribs: nyams chag sdig sgrib mthol zhing bshags: badz+ra sa ma ya shud+dhe ā: brgyad pa rang gsal gdab pa ni: langs te pad kor bya zhing: hūm̐: rtsa ba gsum gyi dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir: skye med ngang las thugs rje'i 'od zer shar: bdag dang dbyer med dbang gi dkyil 'khor 'dir: zhi dang khro gar gtso dang 'khor du gsal: ye nas rang byung rang la shar ba'i phyir: stong pa'i ngang du ma 'dres rang gsal gdab: gu ru dhe wa dhā ki nī sarba sa ma ya s+t+waṃ: dngos gzhi'i ting 'dzin rnam gsum las: dang po de bzhin nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin ni: oṃ:

chos sku mi 'gyur rdo rje yi: pad+ma'i rgyal pos 'di skad smra: dang po chos rnams dmigs med cing: bsam brjod bral ba'i rdzogs pa che: blo 'das chos sku mi 'gyur ba'i: de bzhin nyid kyi ting 'dzin bsgom: gnyis pa kun tu snang ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni: ā: blo bral de yi ngang nyid las: ma rig 'khrul pas bsgribs pa yi: sems can ma lus kun khyab pa'i: brtse ba'i snying rje chen po bsgom: gsum pa rgyu yi ting nge 'dzin ni: hūm̐: stong nyid snying rje'i ngang can des: 'gro don dpag med byed pa la: rang rig gser gyi rdo rje ni: yi ge hrīḥyis mtshan par bsgom: oṃ shū dz+nyā tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ: dharmā dhā tu swa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ: hrīḥbadz+ra tsit+ta sa ma ya hrī: 'byung ba rim brtsegs ni: hūm̐: yi ge hrīḥyi 'phro 'du las: me chu rlung gi bskal pa stong: stong nyid nam mkha'i rang bzhin las: rang byung skyed byed yi ge bdun: e yaṃ raṃ sum keṃ raṃ bh+rūm̐: mkha' la stobs chen rlung gis btegs: rak+ta'i rgya mtsho zhing chen bdal: kiṃ rus bskal pa'i me 'bar gsal: de nas gzhal yas khang bskyed pa ni: hūm̐: rdo rje bh+rūm̐ gyur gzhal yas khang: bde chen pho brang 'od du 'bar: 'ja' tshon bres pa lta bu'i nang: pad 'dab phyi nang mu khyud bcas: gru chad bar khyams sgo rnams mdzes: bhan+dha skam rlon spel mar brtsigs: gnam lcags 'bar ba'i gzer gyis gdams: gza' dang rgyu skar lha klu yi: gdung dang dral phyam ka ba dang: ka zhu ya them ma them byas: thog ni zhing chen brdal ba la: nyi zla 'ja' tshon 'od du 'bar: phyi nang zang thal 'od kyi klong: ma bcos lhun grub ngo mtshar che: bh+rūm̐ bi shwa bi shud+dhe e dz+nyā na tsakra ma dha la bh+rūm̐: rū dra kro ti ti ra baṃ: ma sūr+ya ma dha la: a tsan dra ma dha la: paṃ pad+ma ma dha la: hūm̐ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa: saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐: dam tshig pa bskyed pa ni:

hūm̐: pho brang gzhal yas dkyil 'khor dbus: thugs srog hrīḥyi 'phro 'du las: bdud bzhi nyi zla pad+ma'i steng: bdag nyid dbang chen yab yum sku: zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog dmar: dbu gtsug rta zhal phag gdong mtshan: g.yas g.yon gri gug thod khrag bsnams: zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum 'khril sbyor tshul: dur khrod rus rgyan me klong bzhugs: dbu gtsug pad sdong nyi zla'i steng: rje btsun pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: a tsar gzhon tshul dkar dmar zhal: phyag g.yas rdo rje bhan+dha g.yon: mthing nag zab ber chos gos dmar: pad zhwa sgro dar me long brgyan: snyan cha mgul rgyan kha ṭ+wāṃ 'dzin: skyil krung gzi brjid 'od 'bar bsam: de nyid gnas gyur dran rdzogs su: rang rig bla ma rdo rje 'dzin: mthing nag spyan gsum thor tshugs can: phyag g.yas rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin: phyag g.yon dril bu yum la 'khyud: skyil krung rin chen rgyan drug spras: de yi pang g.yon rig ma ni: ye shes mkha' 'gro mtsho rgyal ma: mdangs ldan bcu drug lon pa'i tshul: gcer bu skra grol rgyan drug mdzes: phyag g.yas gri gug mgul nas 'khyud: g.yon pas thod khrag yab la stob: zhabs gnyis yab kyi sked la 'khril: zung 'jug bdag nyid chen por bsgom: phyogs bzhi pad+ma 'dab bzhi'i steng: shar du rdo rje thod phreng rtsal: rdo rje dhā ru lcags kyu bsnams: sku mdog dkar po dar dkar gsol: lho ru rat+na thod phreng rtsal: rin chen dhā ru zhags pa bsnams: sku mdog ser po dar ser gsol: nub tu pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: pad+ma dhā ru lcags sgrog bsnams: sku mdog dmar po dar dmar gsol: byang du karma thod phreng rtsal: rgya gram dhā ru dril bu bsnams: sku mdog ljang gu dar ljang gsol: thugs kar bhud+dha thod phreng rtsal: 'khor lo dhā ru bhan+dha bsnams: sku mdog smug po zab ber gsol: kun kyang na bza' sbrags ma la: gzi brjid mdangs dang ldan par bskyed:

de yi phyi rim 'dab brgyad la: shar du pad+ma 'byung gnas mthing: rtse lnga g.yas la sdigs mdzub g.yon: gcer bu yum dang 'khril bar bskyed: lho phyogs blo ldan mchog sred dkar: dhā ru g.yas la pad phor g.yon: sngags 'chang gzi brjid ldan par bskyed: nub phyogs nyi ma 'od zer ser: kha ṭ+wāṃ g.yas la nyi zer g.yon: rnal 'byor spyod pa'i lugs su bskyed: byang phyogs seng ge sgra sgrog mthing: rdo rje g.yas la sdigs mdzub g.yon: rab 'jigs khro bo'i tshul du bskyed: shar lhor pad+ma saṃ bha dkar: pad phor g.yas la skyabs sbyin g.yon: dge slong gzhon tshul ldan par bskyed: lho nub pad+ma rgyal po dmar: dhā ru g.yas la me long g.yon: rgyal po gzi brjid ldan par bskyed: nub byang shākya seng ge ser: rdo rje g.yas la lhung bzed g.yon: sprul sku shākya thub par bskyed: byang shar rdo rje gro lod smug: rdo rje g.yas la phur pa g.yon: gtum drag rngam zhing 'jigs par bskyed: phyi rim pad skor bcu drug la: rdo rje mkha' 'gro yab yum dang: rin chen mkha' 'gro yab yum dngaḥ pad+ma mkha' 'gro yab yum dngaḥ las kyi mkha' 'gro yab yum rnams: gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan drug mdzes: sku mdog rigs kyi phyag mtshan 'dzin: gzhan yang rdo rje rin chen dang: pad+ma las kyi shugs 'gror bcas: gri gug thod khrag kha ṭ+wāṃ 'dzin: phyi rol bar khyams 'khor yug la: bdag skyobs lha dang rig 'dzin tshogs: mkha' 'gro chos skyong dam can rnams: glu len gar byed rol mo sgrog: 'dod yon longs spyod sprin ltar gtibs: phrin las bsgrub cing bar chad sel: de ltar yongs rdzogs lha rnams kyang: dngos 'dzin rang rgyud ma yin par: nam mkha' la ni 'ja' tshon bzhin: snang la rang bzhin med par bsgom: 'dzin pas ma bcos gsal bar bskyed: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: bud+dha= badz+ra= rat+na= pad+ma= karma thod phreng rtsal sa ma ya dzaḥdza:

badz+ra gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas sa ma ya dzaḥdza: pad+ma saṃ bha wa sa ma ya dzaḥdza: blo ldan mchog sred sa ma ya dzaḥdza: pad+ma rā dza sa ma ya dzaḥdza: sūr+ya 'od zer sa ma ya dzaḥdza: shākya seng ge sa ma ya dzaḥdza: seng ge sgra sgrog sa ma ya dzaḥdza: badz+ra gro lod sa ma ya dzaḥdza: badz+ra kro dhā ha ya grī wa badz+ra wā ra hi: hrī ma ha ri ni sa: ra tsa hri ya: dhā ki nī badz+ra ging ka ra: gu ru dhe wā dhā ki nī: sarba sa ma ya dza dzaḥ byin rlabs dbang bskur bya ba ni: hrī: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: dam tshig gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir: sku gsung thugs kyis byin rlobs la: ye shes lnga yi dbang skur cig: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ hūm̐ swā āṃ hā gu ru dhe wa dhā ki nī sa ma ya dza dza: brgyad pa spyan drang ba ni: hūm̐ hrī: sngon gyi bskal pa dang po la: o rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshams: dha na ko sha'i mtsho gling du: pad+ma ge sar sdong po la: ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brnyes: pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes su grags: 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor: khyed kyi rjes su bdag bsgrub phyir: byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol: bsil ba tshal gyi dur khrod du: yon tan sna tshogs dngos grub brnyes: pad+ma saṃ bha zhes su grags: 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor: khyed kyi rjes su bdag bsgrub phyir: byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol: rā ga ra ta'i gnas mchog tu: thams cad mkhyen pa'i dngos grub brnyes: blo ldan mchog sred ces su grags: 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor: khyed kyi rjes su bdag bsgrub phyir: byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol: dga' ba tshal gyi dur khrod du: khams gsum dbang sdud dngos grub brnyes: pad+ma rgyal po zhes su grags: 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor: khyed kyi rjes su bdag bsgrub phyir: byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol: so sa gling gi dur khrod du:

'gro ba 'dul ba'i dngos grub brnyes: nyi ma 'od zer zhes su grags: 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor: khyed kyi rjes su bdag bsgrub phyir: byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol: za hor rgyal po'i yul dbus su: bdud 'dul drag po'i dngos grub brnyes: shākya seng ge zhes su grags: 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor: khyed kyi rjes su bdag bsgrub phyir: byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol: ma ga dha yi gnas mchog tu: mu stegs 'dul ba'i dngos grub brnyes: seng ge sgra sgrog ces su grags: 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor: khyed kyi rjes su bdag bsgrub phyir: byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol: stag tshang seng ge bsam 'grub tu: dregs pa tshar gcod dngos grub brnyes: rdo rje gro lod ces su grags: 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor: khyed kyi rjes su bdag bsgrub phyir: byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol: yul gyi ming ni rnga yab gling: zangs mdog dpal ri'i rtse mo na: pad+ma 'od kyi gzhal yas su: sgrub pa mthar phyin dngos grub brnyes: rdo rje thod phreng rtsal du grags: 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor: khyed kyi rjes su bdag bsgrub phyir: byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol: gnas mchog 'di ru byin phob la: sgrub mchog bdag la dbang bzhi skur: bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad sol: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: bde chen 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: dbang gi rgyal po rta mchog dpal: rdo rje phag mo yum dang bcas: dngos grub stsol phyir gshegs su gsol: phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad gzhal yas nas: rigs bzhi mkha' 'gro yum dang bcas: bdud 'dul ging bzhi gshegs su gsol: dpa' bo dpa' mo gshegs su gsol: dur khrod chen po'i gnas brgyad nas: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ma lus dang: rig 'dzin chos skyong thams cad byon:

dbu skra thor tshugs ldems se ldem: dar gyi cod pan pu ru ru: glu len gar byed khyugs se khyug: sil snyan mang po si li li: rgyan cha mang po khra la la: rol mo mang po ti ri ri: dpa' bo'i bro brdung khrabs se khrab: dpa' mo'i glu len kyu ru ru: yi dam lha tshogs ya la la: mkha' 'gro ma tshogs thibs se thib: chos skyong las byed khyugs se khyug: zhub can stong sgra si li li: lha srin sde brgyad sha ra ra: g.yas na pho rgyud thibs se thib: g.yon na mo rgyud spungs se spung: dar gyi ru mtshon lhubs se lhub: dri zhim ngad pa thu lu lu: mkha' 'gro'i brda skad ti ri ri: dpa' bo'i bshud glu kyu ru ru: dpa' mos gar byed shigs se shig: hūm̐ gi snang glu ti ri ri: phaṭaḥkyi brda skad sangs se sang: byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol: gnas mchog 'di ru byin phob la: sgrub mchog bdag la dbang bzhi skur: bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad sol: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol:

gu ru'i 'dzab bzlas shing: rnga yab kyi gling nas lho nub kyi nam mkha' la thibs kyis byon par bsam mo: de nas bzhugs su gsol ba ni: hūm̐: rin chen pho brang nyams re dga': dur khrod gzhal yas byin re che: pad+ma 'dab brgyad mdangs dang ldan: nyi zla brtsegs pa 'od re gsal: rtog med ro gdan bag re dro: bzhugs pa'i gnas su dang re spro: gu ru yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: dgyes shing byin gyis brlab phyir bzhugs: mos pa'i bu la zhal ston 'tshal: gsung gi gdams pa'i gnad bsgrag 'tshal: thugs kyi dgongs pa'i sgo dbye 'tshal: 'gro ba'i don la sku bzhugs 'tshal: gu ru dhe wā dhā ki nī sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: de nas phyag 'tshal ba ni: e ma ho: skye 'gag 'gyur med phrin las rdzogs: rang byung thugs rjes 'gro rnams sgrol: yid bzhin dngos grub char 'beb pa'i: rdo rje thod phreng rtsal la phyag 'tshal lo: spros bral bde chen kun bzang mo: rdo rje sman gcig mtsho rgyal ma: bde stong gnyis med thabs shes sbyor: yab yum gnyis med phyag 'tshal lo: bya byed yid chos rnam par dag: rang byung thugs rjes 'gro rnams sgrol: dbang chen rta mchog yab yum la: gnyis med gus pas phyag 'tshal lo: snang ba yab la stong pa yum: mkha' 'gro ging la phyag 'tshal lo: thams cad chos kyi dbyings su rol: chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo: a ti pū ho: pra tīts+tsha ho: de nas phyi mchod 'bul ba ni: hrī: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la: lha rdzas phyi mchod 'bul ba ni: me tog bdug spos mar me dri: zhal zas sil snyan yid 'ong rnams: spyan shangs thugs ka sku lus dang: zhal du snyan du mchod pa 'bul: gu ru dhe ba dhā ki nī puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+yā shab+da pū tsa ho: de nas nang mchod 'bul ba ni: hrī: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la: rang byung nang mchod 'bul ba ni: dbang po rnam lnga'i me tog 'bul:

gsur chen bdug spos dri yis mchod: zhun chen snang gsal mar mes mchod: rdo rje dri chu'i byug pas mchod: bdud rtsi dri chen zhal zas mchod: rkang gling thod pa'i rnga sgras mchod: dug gsum sku gsung thugs su mchod: dug lnga ye shes lnga ru mchod: snang srid phyag rgya bzhi ru mchod: nang gi mchod pa bzhes su gsol: gu ru dhe wa dhā ki nī: ma hā pañca pū tsa ho: de nas gsang mchod 'bul ba ni: hrī: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la: gnyis med gsang mchod 'bul ba ni: yab yum gnyis med mkha' gsang nas: byang sems dkar dmar bde bas mchod: bde ba'i ro snyom mchod par 'bul: sku lus rgyas phyir bzhes su gsol: gu ru dhe wa dhā ki nī: bo dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha pū tsa ho: de nas sman mchod 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: rang byung gdod nas rnam par dag: rtsa brgyad stong la sbyar ba'i sman: rigs lnga dam tshig lnga yi dngos: ye shes lnga rdzogs grub pa'i rdzas: rgyud lnga'i sems can kun sgrol phyir: dug lnga sel ba'i bdud rtsi che: oṃ āḥhūm̐: sarba pañca a mṛta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhā: hūm̐: rtsa brgyad stong sbyar a mṛta: 'chi med gsang ba'i bdud rtsi 'di: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro mchod: brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol: sarba pañca a mṛta kha raṃ khā hi: thams cad la mtshan don sbyar ro: lce yi dam tshig bdud rtsi la: rdo rje can gyi hūm̐ bsgom ste: mtheb srin thabs shes phyag rgya yis: myong bas dngos grub mchog thob 'gyur: kā ya sid+dhi oṃ: wā ka sid+dhi ā: tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐: de nas dngos grub blang ngo: de nas gtor ma 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: rje btsun pad+ma gshegs su gsol: gdung ba drag pos gsol 'debs kyis: mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa la: 'dod yon lnga yi mchod pa 'bul: bha ling rgyan gyi mchod pa 'bul: sman raka bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul: zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: ting 'dzin rtse gcig mchod pa 'bul:

bla ma rig 'dzin mchod pa bzhes: yi dam lha tshogs mchod pa bzhes: mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams mchod pa bzhes: ging gi tshogs rnams mchod pa bzhes: dpa' bo'i tshogs rnams mchod pa bzhes: dpa' mo'i tshogs rnams mchod pa bzhes: dam can tshogs rnams mchod pa bzhes: rnal 'byor pho mo dam re gtsang: mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams dang re spro: dur khrod gnas mchog nyams re dga': zhing chen bla re rgyan dang ldan: sha sna snying sna bsam mi khyab: spro dga' gnas kyi mchod pa 'bul: hūm̐: snang ba snod kyi 'jig rten gtor gzhong du: srid pa bcud kyi sems can gtor mar sbyar: dpal gyi gtor ma brjid ldan 'gying ba 'di: ri rab lhun po bas kyang dpang re mtho: ma mo'i gtor ma pad+mas bskor ba 'di: gling bzhi gling phran bas kyang bkod re legs: dkar gyi thig gdab dmar gyi gur phub pa: gser gyi ri bdun bas kyang brjid re che: rak+ta dmar gyi ar+ghaṃ sbreng ba 'di: rgya mtsho mching snam bas kyang rgya re che: bdud rtsi sman phud gtor mar sbreng ba 'di: lha yi zhal zas bas kyang ro re mngar: dkar rtsi dmar rtsi sha chen dri chen dang: dri chu byug pa'i rdzas te rnam pa lnga: seng ge glang chen rta dang ba glang dang: mchog chen mi la sogs te rnam pa lnga: ma hā māṃ sa la sogs sha sna stong: ma hā rak+ta la sogs khrag sna stong: ma hā tsit+ta la sogs snying sna stong: ba su ta dang nang rol rnam pa lnga: dbang po lnga dang go ro tsa na dang: shing thog me tog 'bru sna sman rnams dang: zan dang khur ba thug pa'i bye brag dang: mar thud phrum dang zho rtsi 'o mar bcas: tsit+ta tsa ru rtsi chen go snyod dang: lga dang lan tshwa spod kyi bye brag dang: ri sgog klung sgog sha mong sna tshogs dang: bza' dang bca' dang btung ba'i bye brag dang: gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos la sogs: 'dod yon lnga ldan mchod pa sna tshogs kun: thogs med blo yis thams cad kun bsdus te:

ting 'dzin dgongs rgyud dag pas byin brlabs te: bdud rtsir gyur pa'i gtor ma chen po 'dis: rdo rje slob dpon thugs dam bskang gyur cig: yi dam lha tshogs thugs dam bskang gyur cig: mkha' 'gro sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang gyur cig: dpa' bo ging bzhi'i thugs dam bskang gyur cig: dam can srung ma'i thugs dam bskang gyur cig: mchod par 'os pa'i thugs dam bskang gyur cig: ma hā bha ling ta: a mṛ ta ma hā rak+ta khā hi: rak+ta'i mchod pa ni: hūm̐: srid gsum gdug pa bsgral pa'i khrag: 'khor 'das mnyam nyid bhan+dhar bskyil: bde chen rak+ta'i mchod pa yis: rtsa ba gsum gyi thugs dam bskang: ma hā rak+ta khā hi: sbyor ba'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: snang srid thabs shes yab yum du: don dam 'khor 'das gnyis med sbyor: gnyis med byang chub sems kyi rgyus: rgyal ba rgya mtsho mnyes gyur cig: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: pad+ma yo gi ni mu dra pra we sha ya phaṭa: de nas bsgral mchod ni: hūm̐: stong nyid don rtogs blo yis ni: snang srid 'khor 'das gcig tu bsgral: blo ngan 'khor ba'i rgyun bcad do: rgyal ba'i thugs dam bskang gyur cig: ma traṃ rū tra pra we sha ya phaṭa: de nas bstod pa bya ba ni: hrī: ma bcos spros bral bla ma chos kyi sku: bde chen longs spyod bla ma chos kyi rje: pad sdong las byon bla ma sprul pa'i sku: sku gsum rdo rje 'chang la phyag 'tshal bstod: sku ni mi 'gyur kun tu bzang po'i sku: gsung ni mi 'gag mnyam nyid rig pa'i gsung: thugs ni mi g.yo smra bsam brjod las 'das: sku gsung thugs ldan pad+ma'i rgyal la bstod: 'gro ba'i don du rang byung 'od dpag med: bkra shis yon tan du mas brgyan pa'i sku: 'jig rten mnga' bsgyur pad+ma rgyal po'i sras: rdo rje thod phreng rtsal la phyag 'tshal bstod: zhi ba'i las mdzad rdo rje thod phreng rtsal: rgyas pa'i las mdzad rat+na thod phreng rtsal:

dbang gi las mdzad pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: drag po'i las mdzad karma thod phreng rtsal: thams cad lhun grub bud+dha thod phreng rtsal: phrin las rdzogs pa'i rje la phyag 'tshal bstod: bla ma chos sku'i bstod pa ni: hūm̐: dus gsum bde gshegs sku lnga'i bdag nyid 'chang: rgyal ba'i rnam 'phrul pad+ma 'byung gnas ni: dri med rnam dag mthing gsal nam mkha'i mdog: zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dril bus mtshan: thabs shes dbyer med zung 'jug bde ba'i tshul: ye shes lnga ldan rigs lngas dbu la brgyan: longs spyod rab rdzogs dar gyi cod pan mdzes: 'dzum pa'i mdangs ldan byams pa'i 'od zer can: pha rol phyin drug rus pa'i rgyan gyis mdzes: rnam dag bde chen ral pa'i thor tshugs can: mdzes pa'i sku la rin chen rgyan gyis spras: mnyam pa'i skyil krung pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs: thabs mchog de yi sku la mnyam sbyor ma: ye shes mtsho rgyal rdo rje phag mo'i tshul: gzhon nu lang tsho bcu drug lon pa'i sku: dkar dmar mdangs ldan dbu skra thur du 'phyangs: bde ba'i rang bzhin nu ma bha ga rgyas: mdzes pa'i tshul 'chang yab kyi zhal du sbyor: phyag g.yas gri gug yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud: g.yon pas thod khrag dgyes phyir yab la stobs: phyag rgya lnga 'chang rus pa'i rgyan drug mdzes: zung 'jug bde chen zhabs gnyis yab la 'khril: rtog med bde chen yab yum rol pa'i gar: dri med rnam dag sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: bla ma longs sku'i bstod pa ni: hūm̐: skye med ngang nas longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku: bde gshegs yongs rdzogs phrin las 'dus pa'i dpal: lhun grub rigs 'dus gtso la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: dkar gsal mdangs ldan dri ma med pa'i sku: nyon mongs zhi mdzad rdo rje dril bu bsnams: rdo rje thod phreng rtsal la phyag 'tshal bstod: oṃ: sku yi rang bzhin smug nag brjid pa'i mdangs: lhun gyis grub pa'i 'khor lo dril bu bsnams:

bud+dha thod phreng rtsal la phyag 'tshal bstod: ā: 'gag med bde chen pad ma rā ga'i mdog: gsung gi dbang phyug pad+ma dril bu bsnams: pad+ma thod phreng rtsal la phyag 'tshal bstod: swā: gser gyi mdog can yon tan rgyas pa'i sku: yon tan rgyas mdzad rin chen dril bu bsnams: rat+na thod phreng rtsal la phyag 'tshal bstod: hā: kun gyi bdag nyid sku mdog ljang ser mdzes: phrin las rab rdzogs rgya gram dril bu bsnams: karma thod phreng rtsal la phyag 'tshal bstod: bla ma sprul sku'i bstod pa ni: hūm̐: dus gsum bder gshegs rgyal ba'i sras chen po: kun gyi bdag nyid rdo rje thod phreng rtsal: zhal gcig phyag gnyis dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs: sde snod gsum gyis brgyan pa'i chos gos gsol: thams cad yongs rdzogs za 'og ber chen la: lhun grub bde chen gser gyi ha ris can: mi 'gyur snying po rdo rje'i ska rags bcing: theg pa yongs rdzogs pad zhwa mthon mthing la: ma rig mun sel thabs shes nyi zlas brgyan: ye shes lnga ldan dar gyi cod pan 'phur: sa bcu'i mgon po dbu skra sil bur bsil: gzhon nu'i tshul mdzes gser gyi snyan cha 'khrol: sku gsum 'chang ba nor bu'i mgul rgyan spras: thabs shes 'gyur med rdo rje gsor bar mdzad: chags dang rtog med bhan+dha bsnams pa'i tshul: sku gsum mtshon phyir mi mgo skam gsher rlon: dug gsum rtsad gcod kha ṭ+wāṃ rtse gsum brgyan: mdzes pa'i ngang tshul spyan gnyis zhi ma khro: thugs rje'i rang bzhin zla ba rgyas pa'i zhal: skyon gyis ma gos pad sdong mdzes pa'i steng: mi 'gyur bde chen rdo rje'i skyil krung mdzad: phrin las rnam bzhi mkha' 'gro'i 'khor gyis bskor: sprul pa'i sku la mtshan dang dpe byad rdzogs: kun 'dus thod phreng rtsal la phyag 'tshal bstod: mtshan brgyad kyi bstod pa ni: hrī: ma chags skyon gyis ma gos pa'i: pad+ma 'byung gnas sku la phyag 'tshal bstod:

yon tan thams cad rab rdzogs pa'i: pad+ma sam bha'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: shes bya kun la ma rmongs pa'i: blo ldan mchog sred sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: khams gsum srid gsum dbang sdud pa'i: pad+ma rgyal po'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: rmongs pa'i mun sel 'gro ba 'dul: nyi ma 'od zer sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: log 'dren bdud bzhi tshar gcod pa'i: shākya seng ge'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: mu stegs dam sri 'dul mdzad pa'i: seng ge sgra sgrog sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: dregs pa dgra bgegs tshar gcod pa'i: rdo rje gro lod sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: snang ba ma 'gag thugs rje chen po'i sku: rta mgrin dbang gi sku la: skye med rnam dag chos dbyings dag pa'i klong: rdo rje phag mo yum la phyag 'tshal bstod: skye 'gag gnyis su med pa'i mkha' dbyings las: thugs rje ma 'gag cir yang ston cing sprul: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: dam tshig gi bshags pa bya ba ni: hūm̐: bla ma rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro dgongs: rang rig bla ma kun tu bzang: ma rtogs gnyis 'dzin blos bzung ba: dbyer med klong du bzod par gsol: oṃ gu ru satwa sa ma ya: sogs/ zhes yig brgya bzlas so: de nas 'dzab la 'jug ste: tshig gis gsal gdab 'di skad bskul: hūm̐: gsang 'dus bla ma'i dkyil 'khor du: pho brang mtha' dbus med pa yi: bde chen 'od kyi gzhal yas su: pad+ma stong ldan nyi zla'i steng: rje btsun pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: sku gsum sku lnga mtshan brgyad bcas: mkha' 'gro sde bzhi shugs 'gro dang: ging dang dpa' bo dpa' mo'i tshogs: dam can bka' sdod srung mar bcas: skye med chos sku'i klong yangs nas: 'gag med gsung gi sngags sgra sgrog: dzap kyis sku gsum gnad nas bskul: spros pas rgyal ba mchod pas mnyes: bsdus pas dngos grub bdag la thim: bsnyen sgrub mtha' ru ma phyin bar: srog gi phyir yang mi gtong ngo:

rig pa hur phyung nyams rtogs spar: bsnyen dus bla ma spyi bor bsgom: gsol 'debs tshul du dzap 'di bzla: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: sgrub dus bla ma snying gar bsgom: mchod bstod tshul du dzap 'di bzla: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: badz+ra sa ma ya dza: sid+dhi pha la hūm̐ ā: las sbyor bla ma rang gsal gdab: phrin las sgrub pa'i tshul du bzla: hrī ma ha ri ni sa ra tsa hri ya: tsit+ta hring hring dzaḥdza: bdun 'bum nyi khri rtags dang sbyar: skabs su drag po'i hūm̐ bsgrub bya: gnad nas bskul zhing dngos grub blang ba ni: hūm̐: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dgongs: dang po bsnyen cing bar du bsgrubs: da lta bdag dang gnyis su med: 'dir 'dus rnal 'byor bdag cag gis: dkyil 'khor gsum du bsnyen cing bsgrubs: bsnyen sgrub las sbyor mtha' ru phyin: deng sang skya rengs dang po shar: rdo rje srin po'i nam langs nye: dngos grub 'byung ba'i dus la bab: rgyal ba thugs rje'i rang bzhin la: gnad nas bskul brda mi 'tshal yang: deng sang thugs dam gnad nas bskul: gsang ba thugs kyi dpal be 'u nas: sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol: zhes pad kor bya zhing thal mo sbyar: phyi nang 'chams shing dngos grub blang: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: de nas rjes kyi las khrid bcu bzhi las: dang po thugs dam bskang ba ni: spyan gzigs rdzas kyis sku la bskang: bshags pa'i tshig gis gsung la bskang: mtha' bral lta bas thugs la bskang: mchod pas thun mong du bskang ba'o: de la rnal 'byor pa rnams mchod pa'i rdzas su gyur tshad dang: tshogs dang mar me bdud rtsi dang: dril bu la sogs thogs la: dkyil 'khor la 'chams stabs su bskor: de ni 'dod yon rdzas kyis sku la bskang ba'o: de nas bshags pa'i tshig gis gsung la bskang ba ni:

hūm̐: dur khrod gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor du: gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor gzhung bzhin bshams nas kyang: sgrub rdzas gnyan po gzhung bzhin bkram lags na: rdo rje slob dpon thugs dam bskang gyur cig: yi dam lha tshogs thugs dam bskang gyur cig: mkha' 'gro chos skyong thugs dam bskang gyur cig: dam can srung ma'i thugs dam bskang gyur cig: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang gyur nas: rnal 'byor bdag gi g.yar dam sor stsol cig: oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐: lta bas thugs la bskang ba ni: kun gzhi ma bcos klong yangs nas: rang rig rang gsal kun tu bzang: gdod nas ma skyes kun bzang mo: dbyer med bde ba chen po la: bskang dang bshags bya bshags pa'i yul: rnam dag spros bral chos kyi sku: chos kyi sku la gnyis su med: gnyis med rtogs pas thugs dam bskang: mchod pas thun mong du bskang ba ni: hūm̐: dam rdzas gtor chen bshams pa yang: ma dang mkha' 'gro bsten phyir 'bul: bdud rtsi sman mchod sbreng ba yang: ma dang mkha' 'gro bsten phyir 'bul: bhan+dha rak+tas bkang ba yang: ma dang mkha' 'gro bsten phyir 'bul: dur khrod rdzas mchog bkram pa yang: ma dang mkha' 'gro bsten phyir 'bul: rkang gling thod pa'i rnga sgra yang: ma dang mkha' 'gro bsten phyir 'bul: zhun chen snang gsal bltams pa yang: ma dang mkha' 'gro bsten phyir 'bul: māṃ sa'i gsur dud btang ba yang: ma dang mkha' 'gro bsten phyir 'bul: rdo rje dri chu'i byug pa yang: ma dang mkha' 'gro bsten phyir 'bul: 'dod yon ro mchog spungs pa yang: ma dang mkha' 'gro bsten phyir 'bul: thugs dam gnyan po bskangs nas kyang: g.yar dam gnyan po sor stsol cig: gu ru dhe wa dhā ki nī ma hā pañca: ma hā ba liṃ ta: ma hā rak+ta khā hi khā hi: dgongs pas mchod pa ni: hūm̐: dam rdzas rgyan gyi mchod pa 'di dag kun: gnyis med mnyam pa'i ngang du 'bul lags na:

blang dor med pa'i tshul gyis bzhes nas kyang: thim pa'i tshul gyis dgyes pa chen por rol: de nas tshogs 'khor bya ba ni: tshogs kyi yo byad 'tshogs tshad bshams la: swa bhā wa sa sbyang: dri chu dang bdud rtsi gtor la: oṃ sarba dra byaṃ sho dha ni hūm̐ phaṭa: ces bsang: de nas spyan drang ba ni: hūm̐: rje btsun pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: dbang chen yab yum gtso dang 'khor: mkha' 'gro dpa' bo ging dang bcas: sku la sgrib sems mi mnga' yang: 'gro rnams bsod nams gsag pa'i phyir: ye shes tshogs la gshegs su gsol: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: sa ma ya s+t+waṃ: de nas tshogs phrin gdab pa ni: bla ma'i mdun du thal sbyar pus btsugs la: ho dgongs su gsol lo: spros pa med pa'i dbyings: rang bzhin rnam par dag pa na: o rgyan yab yum mkha' 'gro sde bzhi'i tshogs dang bcas pa: dbang chen yab yum zhi khro'i lha tshogs: dam can srung ma dang bcas pa: 'dir 'dus kyi rig 'dzin rdo rje slob dpon: rnal 'byor pho mo'i tshogs rnams dgongs su gsol: rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs khyed rnams kyi thugs dam bskang zhing rnal 'byor pa bdag gi g.yar dam stsol ba'i phyir: tshogs 'khor gzhung bzhin du 'bul lags na: thugs rjes dgongs te bzhes par ci gnang: zhes zhu'o: slob dpon gyis: ho: bla ma yang snying 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor lha rnams dang: rdo rje slob dpon rnal 'byor pho mo mched dang lcam dral rnams kyi thugs rjes yal bar mi dor ba'i phyir: gsol bar gnang gis 'byor tshogs gzhung bzhin du drongs shig: a la la ho: de nas byin gyis brlab pa ni: hūm̐: rang nyid lha yi thugs ka nas: tshogs 'khor sbyang phyir yi ge spro: raṃ las me byung dngos 'dzin bsreg: yaṃ las rlung byung bag chags gtor: khaṃ las chu byung gnyis 'dzin bkrus: hūm̐: rang nyid lha yi thugs ka nas: byin gyis brlab pa'i yi ge spro: hūm̐ gis rnam par rtog pa sbyangs: āḥyis ye shes bdud rtsir bsgyur:

oṃ gyis 'dod yon snang srid khengs: hrīḥyis mthong snang lha tshogs dgyes: de nas tshogs phud rim gsum spros te: dang po mchod pa ni: hūm̐: bde bar gshegs so bcom ldan 'das: sangs rgyas kun gyi bdag nyid che: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la: zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol: gu ru dhe wa dhā ki nīḥg ṇa tsakra pū tsa khā hi: bar pa bshags pa ni/ hūm̐: sngon byung dus nas da lta'i bar: ma rig bdag lus ngag sems kyis: rtsa ba yan lag chag nyams sogs: 'dod yon tshogs kyi mchod pas bshags: badz+ra sa ma ya shud+dhe a: tha ma dgra gzugs phur pas gzir ba ni: hūm̐: che mchog pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: rngam drag gtum pa'i rang bzhin las: yak+sha mi dbal skar ltar 'khrugs: las kyi pho nyas stong gsum khengs: g.yas pas rdo rje phur pa 'dril: g.yon pas lcags kyu zhags pa 'dzin: dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i dus la bab: rdul phran bzhin du brlag par mdzod: badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: nṛ tri sha trūṃ dgra bgegs 'byung po mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa: bstab pa ni: hūm̐: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro zhal phyes shig: khams gsum yongs sgrol dgra bgegs zhal du bstab: rngams byed hom khung yangs pa'i mgul du stims: 'khor 'das mnyam nyid ngang du mchod par bzhes: gu ru dhe wa dhā ki nī: dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag rus pa la kha kha khā hi khā hi: de nas rim par drangs te: ho: gzigs shig mdzes ldan dam pa'i chos: 'di la the tshom byar mi rung: bram ze khyi dang gdol pa phag: rang bzhin gcig tu dgongs te rol: zhes pas drang bar bya'o: de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyis pad+ma'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas 'di skad do: a la la ho: rin thang med la legs 'ong chos: 'dod chags dri ma rnam par dag: gzung dang 'dzin pa kun spangs pa'i: de bzhin nyid la bdag phyag 'tshal: zhes pas lag tu bzhes te rol lo: de bzhin du mched dang lcam dral la drang ngo:

de nas lhag ma rnams rim gyis bsdus te: rdo rje slob dpon gyis kha chus bran: lhag phud bsre ste: hūm̐: dang po phud kyis mi mchod rgyu: bla ma yi dam phud kyi bdag: de nas lhag mas mi mchod rgyu: 'khor tshogs rgya mtsho lhag la dgyes: tha ma gcig tu mi bsre rgyu: chos nyid ye nas rgyu 'bras gcig: lhag ma kha chus mi bran rgyu: khyod dang nga gnyis dam tshig gcig: hūm̐: dpal gyi bka' nyan tshogs kyi lhag sdud rnams: dbang gi bka' nyan ma mo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: las rnams zhal gyis bzhes pa'i dam can rnams: dpal gyi bka' sdod ci bgyis bka' nyan tshogs: mkha' 'gro ging bcas lang ka'i tshogs dang bcas: dur khrod bdag mo ma bdun sring bzhi dang: 'bar ma pho nya dbang phyug nyi shu brgyad: dur khrod chas gsol 'jigs pa'i sgeg tshul can: me tog chun 'phyangs dril bu'i ska rags can: phyag na rat+na'i gzhong thogs gtor len ma: lhag gtor 'di bzhes dpal gyi bka' lung bzhin: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod: oṃ uts+tshiṣ+ṭa bha ling ta badz+ra a ti tra sha sa ma ya khā hi khā hi: hūm̐ hrīḥbh+yo bh+yo: zhes pas btang ngo: de nas thugs dam bskul ba ni: hūm̐: ma g.yel ma 'phang rig 'dzin tshogs: ma g.yel ma 'phang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: ma g.yel ma 'phang ging gi tshogs: ma g.yel ma 'phang dpa' bo'i tshogs: ma g.yel ma 'phang dpa' mo'i tshogs: ma g.yel ma 'phang dam can tshogs: rje btsun pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: rang bzhin gnas nas sku skyod la: mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang gshegs su gsol: ging gi tshogs dang gshegs su gsol: dpa' bo'i tshogs dang gshegs su gsol: dpa' mo'i tshogs dang gshegs su gsol: dam can tshogs dang gshegs su gsol: chos kyi dbyings nas sku skyod la: rdo rje phag mos byin gyis rlobs: dur khrod gnas nas sku skyod la: rigs bzhi mkha' 'gros byin gyis rlobs: nam mkha'i dbyings nas sku bskyod la:

rdo rje phra men byin gyis rlobs: rgya mtsho'i gling nas sku skyod la: gling bzhi mkha' 'gros byin gyis rlobs: phyogs bzhi'i mtshams nas sku skyod la: las byed mkha' 'gros byin gyis rlobs: gangs dkar rtse nas sku skyod la: rdo rje ging chen byin gyis rlobs: gnas mchog 'di ru byin phob la: sgrub mchog bdag la dbang zhig skur: bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad sol: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: de nas thugs dam tha tshig gis gnad nas bskul ba ni: hūm̐: yul gyi ming ni rnga yab gling: zangs mdog dpal ri'i rtse mo ru: pad+ma 'od kyi gzhal yas su: gnas mchog dam pa nyams re dga': gnas mchog nyams su mi dga' rgyu: rje btsun pad+ma thod phreng dang: ye shes mkha' 'gro mtsho rgyal gnyis: skye shi med pa'i sku brnyes nas: srin po rnams la dam chos ston: mkha' 'gro rnam bzhi'i 'khor gyis bskor: ging chen sde bzhi bran du khol: lha srin sde brgyad pho nyar 'gyed: gdong dmar srin po thabs kyis 'dul: dbu la rin chen rgyan gyis brgyan: rus pa'i rgyan cha khro lo lo: sil snyan mang po si li li: cod pan dar 'phyang pu ru ru: rol mo mang po ti ri ri: glu len gar byed khyugs se khyug: khyed kyi rjes su bdag bsgrub phyir: byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol: gnas mchog 'di ru byin phob la: sgrub mchog bdag la dbang zhig skur: bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad sol: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: zhi rgyas dbang drag so so yi: phrin las myur du khyed kyis sgrubs: bsgral ba'i zhing bcu khyed kyis sgrol: sangs rgyas bstan pa khyed kyis srungs: dkon mchog dbu 'phang khyed kyis bstod: rnal 'byor sku dgra khyed kyis thul: lha 'dre mi gsum dbang du sdus: 'byung bzhi'i nad rnams khyed kyis sol: dug lnga'i rnam rtog zhi bar mdzod: de rjes gtor dbang bskur ba ni:

gtor ma bsnyen sgrub kyi dus na lha dang mchod rdzas su shes pa: dbang gi dus rtsa ba gsum yongs rdzogs su shes pa: rjes su rol dus su dngos grub tu shes pa dang gsum gyis rtsa gsum yongs rdzogs kyi gtor ma de dbang tshig gis bskur zhing 'di skad do: hūm̐: gsang ba bla med rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor du: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las 'dus pa'i dpal: dus gsum bla ma rnams dang gcig pa la: dngos grub kun 'byung lha dang gnyis su med: ma mo mkha' 'gro dbang du sdud pa'i phyir: dam rdzas gtor chen mchog gi dngos grub zhu: rje btsun bla ma pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: 'gyur med sku yi sgo phyes la: 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub stsol: rnam dag gsung gi sgo phyes la: tshangs dbyangs drug cu'i dngos grub stsol: spros bral thugs kyi sgo phyes la: phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub stsol: bum pa bzang dang dpag bsam nor bu'i tshul: dgos 'dod yid bzhin 'grub pa'i dngos grub stsol: 'gyur med sku yi dngos grub stsol: 'gag med gsung gi dngos grub stsol: 'khrul med thugs kyi dngos grub stsol: yon tan re skong dngos grub stsol: phrin las 'gro 'dul dngos grub stsol: 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub stsol: 'dzad med nor gyi dngos grub stsol: rgyud 'dzin srid kyi dngos grub stsol: thun mong yid bzhin dngos grub stsol: bla med mchog gi dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐: gu ru dhe wa dhā ki nī: kā ya wā ka tsit+ta sid+dhi a bhi ṣiñca ā: zhes pas dbang bzhi blang zhing gzhan la yang bskur ro: de nas tshe 'gugs pa ni: rgyas par sgrub chen du shes la: bsdus pa bya na: zan gyi tshe bum pad+ma 'dab bzhi dang: tshe ril gyis bskor: kha rgyan rtse la rdo rje nyi zla rta mgos mtshan pa'i nang du bdud rtsis bkang: tshe chang la mar gyi ze kha bya: tshe bum de nyid mi dmigs pa las: tshe dpag med ji lta ba bzhin bskyed:

bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro rnams kyis tshe bcud thams cad bsdus par bsam zhing: oṃ badz+ra ā yu dz+nyā na hūm̐ bh+rūm̐: sid+dhi pha la hūm̐ hrī: zhes ci 'grub bzlas par bya'o: de nas tshe yi mda' dar dmar po g.yab cing 'di skad do: hūm̐: bcom ldan mgon po tshe dpag med: sku mdog dmar po longs spyod rdzogs: phyag na tshe yi bum pa bsnams: gsang ba thugs kyi bum pa nas: snying po thugs kyi ā yu stsol: bdag cag rdo rje'i tshe thob shog: ces pas yang yang bskul: de'i rjes su tshe dpag med kyi snying po bzlas shing dbang bskur: dngos grub tu rol zhing tshe chang btung ngo: de nas chad mdo bya ba ni: gtor ma dpag: rnga brdung: dud 'bud: rak+ta bran la 'di skad do: bh+yo: sngon tshe 'das dus bskal pa dang po la: 'og min gnas mchog bde chen pho brang du: bcom ldan dpal chen pad+ma he ru kas: rta skad gsum bsgrags snang srid ma mo bsdus: tha tshig gsum gyis dam la btags pa'i tshe: phag mo la sogs mkha' 'gro bye ba brgyas: so so'i gzugs mchog dam pa bstan nas kyang: g.yar dam can la dngos grub stsol ba dang: bka' yi gtor ma blang bar ma chad dam: bcol ba'i phrin las bsgrub par ma chad dam: rnal 'byor tshe srog bsring bar ma chad dam: sngon tshe zhal bzhes dam la ma 'da' bar: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: thugs dam rgyud bskul bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod: bh+yo: de 'og bar gyi bskal pa dbus ma la: brag dmar bsam yas ar+ya pā gling du: slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas dang: slob ma'i dwangs ma rje 'bangs grogs lnga yis: dbang chen yongs rdzogs dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: dur khrod gnas pa'i mkha' 'gro sde brgyad dang: dregs pa sde brgyad brtan ma bcu gnyis kyis: so so'i gzugs mchog dam pa bstan nas kyang: g.yar dam can la dngos grub stsol ba dang: bka' yi gtor ma blang bar ma chad dam: bcol ba'i phrin las bsgrub par ma chad dam:

rnal 'byor tshe srog bsring bar ma chad dam: sngon tshe zhal bzhes dam la ma 'da' bar: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: thugs dam rgyud bskul bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod: bh+yo: de 'og bar gyi bskal pa tha ma la: lho brag mkhar chu gnyan gyi dben gnas su: slob dpon pad+ma mkhar chen mtsho rgyal dang: nam mkha'i snying po lang gro lo tsā yis: yang gsang bla ma'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: dbang phyug nyer brgyad mkha' 'gro sum cu gnyis: ging dang lang ka brtan mar bcas pa yis: so so'i gzugs mchog dam pa bstan nas kyang: g.yar dam can la dngos grub stsol ba dang: bka' yi gtor ma blang bar ma chad dam: bcol ba'i phrin las bsgrub par ma chad dam: rnal 'byor tshe srog bsring bar ma chad dam: sngon tshe zhal bzhes dam la ma 'da' bar: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: thugs dam rgyud bskul bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod: bh+yo: de 'og lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la: rnga yab gling phran zangs mdog dpal ri'i rtser: slob dpon chen po pad+ma thod phreng dang: rig 'dzin sngags 'chang rat+na gling pa yis: rtsa ba gsum gyi dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: bse lang mkha' 'gro bka' sdod sgrol ging bzhi: gter srung dam can rgya mtshor bcas pa yis: so so'i gzugs mchog dam pa bstan nas kyang: g.yar dam can la dngos grub stsol ba dang: bka' yi gtor ma blang bar ma chad dam: bcol ba'i phrin las bsgrub par ma chad dam: rnal 'byor tshe srog bsring bar ma chad dam: sngon tshe zhal bzhes dam la ma 'da' bar: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: thugs dam rgyud bskul bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod: bh+yo: gdug pa'i dam nyams dgra dang bgegs: bstan pa'i ru tra ma gtogs pa'i: steng 'og phyogs mtshams gnas pa yi: lha klu gzhi bdag sku bzur cig: gtor zor dgra dang bgegs la 'phen: kun kyang grogs mdzod dmag dpung skyed:

ces gtor ma bteg go: de nas brtan ma skyong ba ni: bh+yo: 'jig rten bod khams skyong ba brtan ma'i tshogs: bdag nyid chen mo rdo rje kun grags ma: dpal ldan ha ri rdo rje g.ya' ma skyong: gangs kyi g.yu bun rdo rje kun tu bzang: 'brog chen 'khor 'dul rdo rje bgegs kyi gtso: bdud mo chen mo dbang chen khyed bzhi yang: 'dir gshegs bka' yi gtor ma 'di long la: dam bcas bzhin du bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod: sha med gangs dkar rdo rje g.yu sgron ma: kha rag khyung btsun rdo rje dpal gyi yum: gter chen mkha' lding rdo rje klu mo dang: rma ri rab 'byams rdo rje drag mo rgyal: gnod sbyin chen mo mthu chen khyed bzhi yang: 'dir gshegs bka' yi gtor ma 'di long la: dam bcas bzhin du bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod: kong btsun de mo rdo rje bod khams skyong: btsan la rol pa'i rdo rje sman gcig ma: g.yu yi dril bu rdo rje zi le ma: sman btsun khug chos rdo rje g.yar mo bsil: sman mo chen mo bzhin mdzes khyed bzhi yang: 'dir gshegs bka' yi gtor ma 'di long la: dam bcas bzhin du bcol pa'i phrin las mdzod: bh+yo: brtan ma skyong mdzad ma sring khyed rnams kyang: dpon g.yog mang po sman phran 'bum dang bcas: slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas dang: slob ma mthu chen rlangs chen dpal seng gis: rnal 'byor tshogs kyi gral du bcug nas kyang: ru dra bsgral ba'i zhing chen gdan la bzhag: dbang bskur dbang rtags spyi bor cod pan btags: dam tshig gnyan gyi bdud rtsi lce la bzhag: dbang rtags rdo rje phur pa lag tu gtad: gsang sngags 'chang ba'i bran du khas blangs nas: ma 'ongs thar pa thob par lung yang bstan: da rung khyed rnams 'jig rten ma 'das kyi: 'jig rten ma 'das bar du dam bcas bzhin: 'dir gshegs bka' yi gtor ma 'di long la: dam bcas bzhin du bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod: ma ma hring hring ba ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi:

zhes brtan ma skyong zhing: rjes la gtor gzhong bdud rtsis bshal la yang mchod do: de nas rta bro ni: gtor gzhong ri rab 'og tu dgra bgegs dgug gzhug drag tu byas te: mched lcam rnams lu gu rgyud du sbrel te: dang po glu bro'i lha tshogs spyan drang ba ni: hūm̐: gsang 'dus bla ma'i dkyil 'khor du: dgra bgegs dam sri bsgral ba'i phyir: rta mgrin khro rgyal sprul par bcas: mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas nas ni: thabs dang shes rab 'brel ba'i las: glu bro gar gyis thugs dam bskul: rgyun chad med par rab brtan zhing: bro ni 'bar ba'i phyag rgya yin: rgyal ba stong dang mnyam par sbyor: glu ni tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyis 'dren: ma dang mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskul: tshig ni don dam rtogs pa'i tshig: 'khor 'das gnyis su med par rtogs: 'di ni glu dang gar gyi brda: dus gsum rgyal ba zhi khro bskul: gar ni khyab gdal rig pa'i gar: zhing khams phyogs bcur khyab par byed: phyag rgya bsnol ba lu gu rgyud: rtsa ba gsum gyi lha tshogs rnams: sngon gyi thugs dam ji bzhin du: glu bro gar la gshegs su gsol: zhes bro bskor ro: de nas bros mnan te: hūm̐: gsang 'dus bla ma'i dkyil 'khor du: bar chad dam sri 'dul ba'i lha: dbang chen rngam pa'i sgra sgrog cing: dpal gyi rta skad tse re re: khro bo'i 'brug sgra ti ri ri: rol pa'i rta bro chems se chems: bdud dang dam sri rdul du rlog: sngon gyi thugs dam bskang ba'i phyir: kun tu bzang mo'i mkha' dbyings su: khams gsum yongs sgrol chen po'i bro: za byed pho nya'i dkyil 'khor du: dug lnga rus pa'i phung po la: gcan gzan chen po'i bro brdungs pas: bdag tu lta ba'i zhe sdang bcom: khrag 'thung chen po'i dkyil 'khor du: rak+ta'i rgya mtsho 'khyil pa la: ma tshogs mkha' 'gro'i bro brdungs pas: kun tu zhen pa'i 'dod chags bcom: rngam chen 'khrug pa'i dkyil 'khor du:

māṃ sa sha chen spungs pa la: sder chags 'dus pa'i bro brdungs pas: rmongs pa'i gti mug ngo bo bcom: gtum chen 'khrugs pa'i dkyil 'khor du: dbang po yan lag rdzogs pa la: gshog pa rdo rje'i bro brdungs pas: kun tu rmongs pa'i phrag dog bcom: 'jigs byed chen po'i dkyil 'khor du: dbus kyi khri rkang zlum po la: rdo rje mchu yi bro brdungs pas: bdag tu 'dzin pa'i nga rgyal bcom: sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor du: dug gsum 'joms pa'i bro brdungs pas: sngon gyi dam tshig chen po bskang: ma tshogs dhā ki'i da la ru: stan ghan sprul pa'i las byas pas: khams gsum bsgral ba'i cho ga rdzogs: phyag brnyan chen po'i da la ru: bka' 'das bsgral ba'i las byas pas: rū tra mnan pa'i cho ga rdzogs: oṃ hrīḥbadz+ra kro ta ha ya grī wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ laṃ: hūm̐ laṃ: suṃ laṃ: s+t+waṃ bha ya nan: dgra bgegs sarba sha truṃ s+t+waṃ bha ya nan: zhes sa rim pa dgus g.yogs so: dkyil 'khor mtha' nas rdo rjes bsdu zhing: hūm̐: chos sku skye med stong pa'i ngang nyid las: yang gsang bla ma'i dkyil 'khor 'ja' ltar shar: 'gro kun srid pa'i mtsho las rab bsgral nas: skye med chos dbyings ngang du badz+ra mu: zhes dang: ā li kā li: yi ge brgya pa bzla'o: rgyun spyod bya ba ni: rdo rje dril bu thugs kar bsnol te: hūm̐: snang stong zung 'jug bde chen lha yi sku: sgo gsum dkyil 'khor gsum gyi ngang nyid las: thugs rje'i rang bzhin gdul bya'i dpal du shar: phrin las rnam bzhis 'gro ba'i don bya'o: de nas smon lam btab ste: na mo: bdag gis bla ma bsgrubs la sogs: dus gsum tshogs gnyis ci bsags pa'i: 'bras bu dus 'dir smin gyur cig: yon tan ma lus yongs rdzogs nas: phrin las gang brtsam myur 'grub cing: bdag gzhan gnyis med sangs rgyas shog: ces smon lam gzhan yang rgya cher btab bo:

de nas me tog 'thor zhing bkra shis brjod: ho: chos sku'i bkra shis mtha' yas 'od dpag med: mi 'gyur rdo rje sku yi bkra shis shog: longs sku'i bkra shis byams mgon thugs rje can: 'gag med tshangs dbyangs gsung gi bkra shis shog: sprul sku'i bkra shis rig 'dzin thod phreng rtsal: gdul bya dpal 'byor rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog: gsang yum bkra shis mkha' 'gro mtsho rgyal ma: bde stong rgyun chad med pa'i bkra shis shog: gdams pa'i bkra shis yang gsang bla med chos: gsang sngags bstan pa dar rgyas bkra shis shog: rdo rje slob dpon sgrub pa'i mched dang lcam: dus gsum 'du 'bral med pa'i bkra shis shog: bsnyen sgrub mthar phyin 'di yi byin rlabs kyis: 'gro rnams bde chen zhing du skye ba dang: ting 'dzin zas kyis rtag tu 'tsho byed cing: thog ma'i rang bzhin sa la 'khod par shog: ces rnal 'byor pa rnams kyis bkra shis brjod: dga' ston bya zhing tshogs 'khor rol: bkra shis pa'i glu dang bro la sogs pa yang bya'o: rgya rgya rgya: o rgyan gyi thugs sgrub yang snying 'dus pa'i las byang rin chen phreng ba zhes bya ba slob dpon pad+mas gsung bzhin du: bdag 'dra nam mkha'i snying po yis: gnyal smad dge ri'i brag phug tu: yi ger bkod pa 'di yongs su rdzogs pa'o: e ma bdag 'dra rig 'dzin pad+ma thod phreng gis: kun gyi snying po bla ma'i thugs sgrub brtsams: spel ba'i dus min ma 'ongs dus kyi phyir: rje 'bangs grogs lngas bskul phyir bdag gis bshad: dus kyi tha ma lnga bcu kha ral dus: skal ldan las can gcig dang 'phrad nas kyang: gsang sngags mi nub bstan pa'i sgron mer shog: rgya rgya: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gnyal smad dge ri gsang ba'i dbang phug nas// rta yi lo la gu ru rata gling ngas// gsang sngags mi nub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'di// bton nas shog ser ngos la zhal bshus so// dge'o/
